title: Stochastic Processes
description: Chance that unfolds in time: a walk with random steps, a clock with random ticks, a chain whose next state depends only on this one. Unlocks Markov Chain Links, Poisson Clocks and Brownian Suspension.

puzzle.goal: A drunkard takes N steps of length a, each in a direction chosen by chance. Write how far x from the start he typically ends up.
puzzle.name: Random walk spread
puzzle.ask: Find x in metres for N = @{N} steps of a = @{a} m.
puzzle.method: The steps are independent, so their variances add: N·a². The typical distance is the square root.
